typography.displayRole: none — R09 is sans-led at every level; hierarchy comes from weight, size and colour rather than a display face
typography.uiRole: one geometric-humanist grotesque for everything; bold for property names and headings, semibold for prices and actions

composition.home: Greeting-scale heading, a search field, a single row of property-type chips, then a card grid with one large media block per card and the rent as the last read in the card body.
composition.detail: Media header, property name, area, meta line, rent, then a stat trio (bedrooms / bathrooms / verified), a labelled detail list, the visit-slot choice, the visitor form, and one pinned primary action.
composition.density: Moderate and even. Cards carry one media block and four text lines; the detail view is a stack of white panels on a light grey canvas.

grammar.cta: One pill shape, indigo fill, white text, full width on mobile.
grammar.selection: Property type is a chip row; visit slots are a two-up option grid marked by indigo fill. Saved is a heart toggle on the card and on the detail header.
grammar.numbers: Rent is identical on the card, the detail and the confirmation; deposit is shown as a detail row, never as a second price in the card.
grammar.status: Verified is a tint pill on the card; unverified properties simply omit it rather than showing a negative badge.
grammar.errors: Inline under the field, in the error colour, with the field ringed.

imagery.role: R09 leads with photography. No images are available offline, so each card carries a deterministic gradient block with the property's initials. Declared substitution — it preserves the media slot and the card rhythm but not the photographic quality.
imagery.substitution: Deterministic gradient + initials replaces property photography.

provenance.measured: engine/analyze_image.py on the original file: sat>=0.25 = 9.49%, sat>=0.03 = 78.2%, modal hue bin 240deg (indigo-blue), hue family share 42.3% of coloured pixels, 76.1% of pixels above luminance 0.7. Independently re-derived by engine/reference_profile.mjs, which recommends neutral-gallery.
provenance.interpreted: Composition, grammar and role assignments are visual interpretation of the board (forensics/phase1/R09-staynest.md). Font identity is NOT inferred — only the sans role.
uncertainty: The brand hex is a representative indigo from the reference's family, not a sampled flat UI colour; the board is a 36-screen collage with photographic content.
R09 ships no error states and no empty states; both are engine-side invention and are labelled as such.
Photography is the reference's main quality carrier and it is substituted, which caps the visual ceiling.
